card.name: "Of" after a unit of quantity
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after a counting unit like tablet, bottle, pack or teaspoon, usually after "one" or "each". It is followed by a drug, food or product name.

modes.label: Tablet or bottle of drug
modes.description: "of" after one tablet or one bottle, leading into a drug name.
modes.example: Adults: One tablet<< of>> TRIUMEQ daily.

modes.label: Spoon or pack of item
modes.description: "of" after a pack or teaspoon measure, leading into a food or product.

card.writes: It seems to add package or measure-unit words such as strip, strips and monthly, which loosely fits counting-unit wording.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "of" in phrases like "one tablet of" or "a bottle of" in dosing text.
